source_evidence.evidence_summary: Backtrader describes bracket orders with main order, stop-side order and limit-side order submitted together.
Backtrader discusses stop-based strategy mechanisms for limiting losses or securing profits.
QuantConnect states that bars have start and end times and are passed to algorithms at end time to avoid unavailable-bar lookahead.
CFA Institute discusses technical analysis, trend, support/resistance, indicators, oscillators, volume and risk-management context.
CFA Institute discusses trade cost analysis, market impact, execution risk, trading policy documents, and execution-quality improvement.
QuantConnect states that fill models determine fill price and quantity, incorporate spread costs, and work with slippage models.
QuantConnect defines slippage as the difference between expected and actual fill price and models it to make backtests more realistic.
